events.name: UCLA Bruins at Hawai'i Rainbow Wahine

events.name: Texas Longhorns at West Virginia Mountaineers

headlines.description: — Aaliyah Moore scored 20 points to lift fifth-ranked Texas to a 78-73 victory over No. 12 West Virginia in the Gulf Coast Showcase championship on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 5 Texas tops No. 12 West Virginia 78-73 to win Gulf Coast Showcase championship

events.name: North Carolina Central Eagles at LSU Tigers

headlines.description: — Flau’Jae Johnson scored 22 points and Aneesah Morrow had her eighth double-double of the season with 17 points and 11 rebounds to lead No. 7 LSU to a 131-44 victory over North Carolina Central on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 7 LSU steamrolls past North Carolina Central 131-44

headlines.shortLinkText: Serena Sundell scores 17 as No. 9 K-State opens on a 21-1 run in an 86-39 rout of Central Arkansas
